subject: Scheduling demo for Archway Analytics — territory overlap
messages:
From: Jamie Lin <jamie@archwayanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request — Archway Analytics

Hi Monica,

We just signed up on the self-serve flow this morning and I'm hoping to see Redwood in action. We're a mid-market analytics shop (Archway Analytics) evaluating inference costs and multi-region deployment. Would love a 30-minute demo this week to walk through latency/SLA behavior and routing options.

Quick background: 12 engineers, AWS us-west primary, strict data residency for a couple of EU customers.

My availability (PST):
- Tue 6/29 10:00–12:00
- Tue 6/29 16:00–18:00
- Wed 6/30 09:00–11:00

Attaching my calendar availability.

Thanks,
Jamie Lin
Director of Platform Engineering
Archway Analytics
[Attachment: availability.ics]

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Lin <jamie@archwayanalytics.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — Archway Analytics

Hi Jamie — thanks for signing up and for the context. Happy to run the demo. I can do Tue 6/29 10:30am PT or Wed 6/30 9:30am PT; both 30-minute slots.

Dylan — I see Archway is flagged under the Northwest territory in our routing table, but Jamie's usage looks like a mid-market eval. Can you confirm ownership? If you're owning, feel free to take the meeting; if not, I can.

Proposed agenda (30m):
- 8m overview of Redwood serving modes (hosted/dedicated/private)
- 10m latency/cost tradeoffs + region routing examples
- 7m Q&A on data residency
- 5m next steps / MAP

I attached a short mutual action plan draft.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
SDR, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-archway-v1.md]

Thanks for the rapid thread everyone. Short decision to keep momentum:

- Owner: Monica will run the 30-minute demo on Wed 6/30 at 9:30am PT. Monica, please use the MAP draft (attached) and share recording and MAP after the call.
- Dylan: you retain post-demo ownership for opportunities that meet your expansion criteria. Grace will hand leads with prior outbound contact to you for follow-through; Monica to qualify during the demo and then pass the deal in HubSpot if it meets AE criteria.
- Jamie: calendar invite sent for Wed 6/30 9:30am PT — Monica will present. If that time doesn't work, reply with an alternate and Monica will rebook.

Monica — attaching the updated MAP link for final. Dylan — I'll update the routing table rule so similar signups gap to the outbound owner next time.
